body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier debuted its digital camera 'DC-L1 270' at CES 2010, which is equipped with a 12.0-megapixel 1/2.3-inch CCD with 3× optical zoom and 4× digital zoom lens. Integrated intelligent features, like Image Stabilization and Face Detection, the DC-L1 270 is a great option for those just starting out with digital photography. It is expected to be available Q1 2010 for $99.99
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
